chunks: As for the hadith that was narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that he said:
"Whoever rides a zāmilah should make a will."

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.زَامِلَةً: a riding mount or pack animal used for travel
key_terms.فَلْيُوصِ: then let him make a will

ai.seo_question: Why should a traveler riding for hajj make a will?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys an instruction connected to travel, especially in the context of hajj, advising a person who undertakes a journey on a riding animal to prepare a will. Its significance lies in encouraging readiness, responsibility, and awareness of the uncertainties of travel.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3127 - As for the narration reported from Abu Abdullah (as) where he said:
"Whoever rides a zamilah (simple mount) should make a will,"
